title: skills(objectstack-platform): the namespace route-literal list names `runs` once install refuses it (#32075 follow-up)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gENvvRYHmL5nFTF5x

Filing gate: ④ coordination — the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of #32075 (install refuses the namespace `runs`, the inbound-hook position literal; card thread branch `claude/project-thread-hkkvip`). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reader: `domain:skills` — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:123` (the `manifest.namespace` paragraph), after #32075's PR merges.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `is:issue "route literals" skills namespace` → 2 hits (#12206, #25222, both closed, other topics); `is:issue namespace runs skill` → 566 hits, the open ones are the ADR-0150 epic family (#31527, #31696, #31699, #31985, #30806), none edits this skill line.
Business reason: the skill tells an AI author which namespaces it may never declare. Once #32075 lands, a package declaring `namespace: 'runs'` is refused at install, `os validate` and build, but the skill's list still reads `actions`, `connectors`, `global`, `hooks`, `oauth`, `trigger`, so an AI author picks `runs` and meets the refusal only at the door.
Blocked-by: #32075

## Owed

1. `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:123`: add `runs` to "Never `actions`, `connectors`, `global`, `hooks`, `oauth`, `trigger` (route literals; `os validate` and build refuse)", in the order the merged `NAMESPACE_POSITION_LITERALS` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/address-grammar.ts`) gives. If an eval in `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/` already asks for the reserved list, extend it; do not add a new eval for one word.

Wording source: the merged #32075 PR (the literal set and the ADR-0150 D5 amendment note).

**Level:** one-word skill text; `skills/**` is governed, so the landing tier follows `check-governed-merges` at landing. Fable review per the maintainer's standing skills rule.

Related: #32075, #32060, ADR-0150 D5.
